# EndSelect <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Control Flow](Language-Features-Control-Flow)

</div>


```blitzbasic
End Select
EndSelect
```

## Description

Ends a [Select](Select) block. `End Select` and `EndSelect` mean the same thing.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Select 1
	Case 1 : Print "one"
End Select
```

```text
one
```
